006package dev.metaschema.core.model.validation;
007
008import java.io.BufferedInputStream;
009import java.io.IOException;
010import java.io.InputStream;
011import java.net.URI;
012import java.net.URL;
013
014import dev.metaschema.core.model.AbstractResourceResolver;
015import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016
017/**
018 * Base class for a content validator.
019 */
020public abstract class AbstractContentValidator
021    extends AbstractResourceResolver
022    implements IContentValidator {
023
024  @Override
025  public IValidationResult validate(URI uri) throws IOException {
026    URI resourceUri = resolve(uri);
027    URL resource = resourceUri.toURL();
028
029    try (InputStream is = new BufferedInputStream(ObjectUtils.notNull(resource.openStream()))) {
030      return validate(is, resourceUri);
031    }
032  }
033}
